purpose: Correct the wording of Stage-1 holdout blindness: B3 was performance-blind, not completely unread. Model results unchanged; no retraining, no re-holdout, checkpoint untouched.
what_was_observed_before_selection: B3-1 preflight counted, for all three splits, whether each record's teacher label is teacher_cp_stm or mate-only. Holdout was seen as label-type metadata only: 29229 usable cp / 771 mate-only.

These counts appear in results/s10/s10-b3-preflight.json and in the Stage-1 selection artifact (bb6383c), and the 2.56% overall mate-only rate was used for a data-sanity decision (no anomalous data loss).

The B3-2 training runs used allow_holdout=False: the Rust exporter received only train+validation records; no holdout FEN, feature, target value, prediction, loss, or MAE was ever computed or observed before selection.
what_was_never_observed_before_selection: holdout features / FEN content during training runs
any model choice influenced by holdout performance
conclusion: The Stage-1 selection (seed 20260818, min validation MAE) was made strictly on validation performance. The holdout evaluation in d224f6d therefore remains a valid generalization estimate; it was merely not 'completely blind' at the metadata level.
